description: Use Ads Manager to discover and manage ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and ads; analyze performance, conversions, and change history; upload creative images; and, when available, complete self-serve account setup. When multiple campaigns need selection, call list_campaigns with include_performance_metrics=true so the gated picker can show recent performance.
